=======
LEGEND
=======

player = You:D
object = player or Crate or Ball or Wall or Fly or Headlong or TimeMachine:D
stopper = player or Crate or Ball or Wall or Fly or Headlong or TimeMachine:D or GateC
cantpush = Wall or Fly or GateC
push = Crate or TimeMachine:D
objectW = CrateW or BallW
water = Pond or Puddle
nogoF = Wall or Fly or GateC or Hole or Headlong
nogoB = Wall or Crate or Crack or Hole or Headlong
crate = Crate or CrateW
ball = Ball or BallW
heavy = player or Crate or Ball
counts = Count:N
targets = TargetYou or TargetCrate or TargetBall or TargetFly or TargetHeadlong

P = You:F and Start
Q = You:B and Start

β = Ball and TargetBall
χ = Crate and TargetCrate
: = Crack and TargetCrate
; = Pond and TargetCrate
& = Ball and TargetCrate

1 = Count:1
2 = Count:2
3 = Count:3
∞ = Count:Inf
∘ = Ink:F
• = Ink:B
@ = Crate and TargetCrate
# = Wall
⋆ = Wall and Star

=======
MAPPINGS
=======

N => Nm
0 1 2 3 Inf -> 3 0 1 2 Inf

D => D_rev
F B -> B F

=======
SOUNDS
=======

sfx0 17551700(reverse)
sfx1 75011107(ball)
sfx2 85372903(generate wall)
sfx3 47068304(cancel)
sfx4 59023902(collapse)
sfx5 18102904(fall)
sfx6 75615703(open)
( sfx? 32904102(death) )

sfx10 84421108(for debag)
( 95062707 )
player move 9405707
Crate move 64059507
restart 24001300
undo 84443307
endlevel 91940500
( 95289108 )

================
COLLISIONLAYERS
================

Background
Pond, Puddle, Crack, Hole
Background2
targets
CrateW, BallW, Button, GateO
Satisfied
Count:N, Ink:D
object, GateC
directions -> Boundary:directions
directions -> Corner:directions
WallShadow
Star
NoGo

Checked
Time:D
Start
Computer
directions -> NotEdge:directions
directions -> Marker:directions
StopFlag
CrackFlag
CancelTurn
OpenFlag
OnlyOneButton
Moment:directions
FallFlag

======
RULES
======

[Start] -> gosub Start
[NoGo] -> []

( Stop conditions )
[> You:F|nogoF] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> You:B|nogoB] -> gosub CancelTurn

[> You:F|water no objectW] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> You:B|Pond  no objectW] -> gosub CancelTurn

[^ You:B|Headlong|no stopper] -> gosub CancelTurn
[v You:B|Headlong|no stopper] -> gosub CancelTurn
[< You:B|Headlong|no stopper] -> gosub CancelTurn

[Computer no CancelTurn] -> gosub HeadlongCome

( Crate )
[> You:F|push] -> [> You:F|> push]
[< You:B|push] -> [< You:B|< push]
[> push |push] -> [> push |> push]
[< push |push] -> [< push |< push]
[> push|Fly  ] -> [> push|Fly] gosub CancelTurn

( Fly )
[< You:F|Fly] -> [< You:F|< Fly]
[> You:B|Fly] -> [> You:B|> Fly]
[> You:B||Fly] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> Fly|Crate] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> Fly|Fly] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> Fly|Ball] -> gosub CancelTurn

[Time:F] -> gosub BallPush
[Time:B] -> gosub BallPull


( Gate penetration )
[> You:B|GateC] -> [> You:B|GateO]
[> You:B|...|> Fly|GateC] -> [> You:B|...|> Fly|GateO]
[> heavy|Button][Computer] -> [> heavy|Button][Computer OpenFlag]
startloop
[Computer no OpenFlag][no push no Ball no objectW|> You:B GateO] -> gosub CancelTurn
[Computer no OpenFlag][stationary push   |> You:B GateO] -> gosub CancelTurn
[Computer no OpenFlag][stationary Ball   |> You:B GateO] -> gosub CancelTurn
[Computer no OpenFlag][stationary objectW|> You:B GateO] -> gosub CancelTurn
[Computer no OpenFlag][no crate no Ball no objectW|> object GateO|...|> You:B] -> [Computer][|object GateO|...|> You:B]
[Computer no OpenFlag][stationary Ball |> object GateO|...|> You:B] -> [Computer][|object GateO|...|> You:B]
endloop

( TimeMachine )
D [> You:D|TimeMachine:D_rev|cantpush] -> [> You:D_rev||cantpush] sfx0
D [> You:D|TimeMachine:D|cantpush] -> [> You:D||cantpush] sfx4

( Stop conditions 2 )
[> object|Wall] -> gosub CancelTurn
[> object|GateC] -> gosub CancelTurn

( Crack )
[Crack > You:F] -> [Puddle > You:F] sfx4
[> You:B|Puddle no objectW] -> [> You:B|Crack] sfx4 

( Water )
[CrateW no object|> You:B] -> [> Crate|> You:B]
[CrateW no object|> Crate no water|...|> You:B] -> [> Crate|> Crate|...|> You:B]

( --- late rules --- )

( Headlong go away )
late [You:F|Headlong|no stopper] -> [You:F|Headlong Moment:>|] sfx1
late [Headlong Moment:>|no stopper] -> [|Headlong Moment:>] sfx1
late [Moment:directions] -> []

( FlipTimeDirection )
late [Computer no CancelTurn] -> gosub FlipTimeDirection
late [CancelTurn] -> []

( Fall )
late [Crate water no objectW] -> [CrateW water] sfx5
late [Ball  water no objectW] -> [BallW  water] sfx5
late [Crate FallFlag] -> [] sfx5
late [Ball  FallFlag] -> [] sfx5
late [Crate Hole] -> [Crate Hole FallFlag] again
late [Ball  Hole] -> [Ball  Hole FallFlag] again

( Button )
late [OpenFlag] -> []
late [GateO no object] -> [GateC]
late [Button heavy][GateC] -> [Button heavy][GateO]
late [Button heavy][Computer] -> [Button heavy][Computer OpenFlag]

( CheckWinCondition )
late [TargetYou You:D] -> [TargetYou You:D Satisfied]
late [TargetYou no You:D Satisfied] -> [TargetYou]

late [TargetCrate crate] -> [TargetCrate crate Satisfied]
late [TargetCrate no crate Satisfied] -> [TargetCrate]

late [TargetBall Ball] -> [TargetBall Ball Satisfied]
late [TargetBall no Ball Satisfied] -> [TargetBall]

late [TargetFly Fly] -> [TargetFly Fly Satisfied]
late [TargetFly no Fly Satisfied] -> [TargetFly]

late [TargetHeadlong Headlong] -> [TargetHeadlong Headlong Satisfied]
late [TargetHeadlong no Headlong Satisfied] -> [TargetHeadlong]

( --- subroutine --- )

subroutine  BallPush
[> object|Ball|no stopper] -> [> object||Ball Moment:>] sfx1
[Ball Moment:>|no stopper] -> [|Ball Moment:>]
[Ball Moment:>|stopper] -> [Ball|stopper]
[Moment:>] -> []

subroutine BallPull
(Normal case)
[< object|no stopper] -> [< object|Marker:<]
[Marker:<|no stopper] -> [Marker:<|Marker:<]
[Marker:<|ball|stopper] -> [Marker:<|Ball Moment:<|stopper]
[Marker:<|Ball Moment:<] -> [Ball Moment:<|]
[< object|Ball Moment:<] -> [< object|< Ball] sfx1
[< object|ball|stopper] -> [< object|< Ball|stopper] sfx1
[Moment:>] -> []
[Marker:>] -> []

( Exceptional case: GateOpen work as  a stopper if Ball activates Button )
[Computer] -> [Computer OnlyOneButton]
[Computer][Button heavy] -> [Computer][Button heavy Checked]
[OnlyOneButton][Button heavy Checked][Button heavy no Checked] -> [][Button heavy][Button heavy]
[Checked] -> []

[< object|no stopper] -> [< object|Marker:<]
[Marker:<|no stopper] -> [Marker:<|Marker:<]
[OnlyOneButton][Marker:<|ball Button|GateO] -> [OnlyOneButton][Marker:<|Ball Moment:< Button|GateO]
[Marker:<|Ball Moment:<] -> [Ball Moment:<|]
[< object|Ball Moment:<] -> [< object|< Ball] sfx1
[OnlyOneButton][< object|ball Button|GateO] -> [OnlyOneButton][< object|< Ball Button|GateO] sfx1
[OnlyOneButton] -> []
[Marker:>] -> []
[Moment:>] -> []

subroutine HeadlongCome

[stopper|Headlong|no stopper] -> [stopper|Headlong|Marker:>]
[Marker:>|no stopper] -> [Marker:>|Marker:>]
[^ You:B|Marker:<|...|Headlong] -> [^ You:B|Headlong|...|] sfx1
[v You:B|Marker:<|...|Headlong] -> [v You:B|Headlong|...|] sfx1
[< You:B|Marker:<|...|Headlong] -> [< You:B|Headlong|...|] sfx1
[Marker:>] -> []

subroutine CancelTurn
[Computer] -> [Computer CancelTurn] sfx3
[> You:D|] -> [You:D|NoGo]
[> object] -> [object]

subroutine Start
( Edge detection )
[Start][no Start] -> [Start][Start]
[Start|Start] -> [Start NotEdge:>|Start NotEdge:<]

( Place computer at upper left corner )
[Start no NotEdge:up no NotEdge:left] -> [Start Computer]
[NotEdge:directions] -> []
[Start no Computer] -> []

( Checkerboard background )
[Start Background no Background2|no Start Background] -> [Start Background|Start Background Background2]
+ [Start Background2|no Start Background] -> [Start Background2|Start Background]
[Start no Computer] -> []

( Generate boundary )
  ( boundary initialization )
  [Boundary:>] -> []
  [Corner:>  ] -> []
  ( generate boundary )
  [Wall no Boundary:>|no Wall] -> [Wall Boundary:>|]
  ( generate corner )
  [Wall no Boundary:^|Boundary:^] -> [Wall Corner:^|Boundary:^]
  [Wall no Boundary:v|Boundary:v] -> [Wall Corner:>|Boundary:v]
 
( generate shadow )
down [Wall|no Wall] -> [Wall|WallShadow]

( set time direction )
D [Computer][You:D] -> [Computer Time:D][You:D]

( remove start marker )
[Start] -> []


subroutine FlipTimeDirection
late D [You:D Ink:D_rev] -> [You:D_rev Ink:D_rev] sfx0
late D N [You:D Count:N no Checked] -> [You:D_rev Count:Nm Checked] sfx0
late [Count:0] -> []
late [Checked] -> []
late D [Computer][You:D] -> [Computer Time:D][You:D]

==============
WINCONDITIONS
==============

all TargetCrate on crate
all TargetBall on Ball
all TargetYou  on You:D
all TargetFly   on Fly  
all TargetHeadlong on Headlong
